Russian Foreign Ministry Spox. Zakharova:
The blockade of Cuba is a disgrace.
In the 21st century, the blockade of an entire state and its people is a disgrace.
You understand, this is not a question of whether it is good or bad. This is not even something that should be discussed in principle.
It is a disgraceful phenomenon of the modern era.

Former U.S. National Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent:
I frankly don't believe that the vast majority of Americans who voted for Democrats last night voted for the Democrats.
They're just angry that he betrayed them, so they voted against Trump.
The brand name of MAGA and Trump is kind of dead, whatever, but the coalition, the things Trump ran on in 2024, it's still there.

Russian Foreign Ministry Spox. Zakharova:
Look at the map. Today, anyone can open a map on their phone or computer. Look at the island of Cuba.
Compare its size with that of the countries, first and foremost the United States of America, that have been putting pressure on this state for decades.
Compare them, and then try to translate this into relations between individuals.
Imagine one person being mistreated, blackmailed and literally bullied by a large number of people or social groups.
This is a disgrace to our modern global civilization.

Former U.S. National Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent:
I am personally surprised and a little disappointed that more senior administration officials and more senior military officers haven't left and resigned.

“I have every intention to keep him,” Trump said.

“I get these calls, you know, about him. I don't understand why.”

Former U.S. National Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent on whether generals would refuse an unlawful order:
If the president gave an order like that, one guy even blinked, he got fired. And there's 10 other ambitious people who say, "I'll roger up and do it."

I don't see a scenario where Bibi goes out quietly. He's just got too much on the line.
